name: Asa
overview: Asa was a male Levite known as the son of Elkanah, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 9:16. His identity is closely tied to his lineage within the tribe of Levi, though additional personal notes about him are not provided.
namesAndTitles: The name Asa, meaning possibly 'healer' or 'myrtle,' is a proper name mentioned in 1 Chronicles 9:16. There is no indication that this name was given by God, and it reflects a common Hebrew personal name without further specified significance.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Asa as the son of Elkanah. It is also inferred that Berechiah was his father, establishing a familial line within the Levite tribe. Beyond these connections, no additional family relationships are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Asa holds a place in the biblical record primarily through his genealogical mention as a Levite descendant of Elkanah. Although not elaborated in the given text, his lineage situates him within the priestly tribe, which is significant for understanding the heritage and roles of Levites in Israel. His mention underscores the continuity of God's people through faithful descendants.
